debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with extreme fear sentiment (33/100) and price near support (18.28) creates contrarian reversal setup if oversold oscillators confirm.
debate.key_bear_argument: Oversold oscillators (RSI, Stoch) lack bullish confirmation, MACD histogram negative, OBV weak, price below short-term EMAs, zero fundamental support, earnings event risk in 52 days, and macro environment in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 311.68, strong dollar headwind) make this a high-risk trap entry.
